252201/wukong-panel.description: Wukong Panel: VPS node deployment, management, and traffic monitoring console
252201/wukong-panel.body:
# Wukong Panel (Wukong Panel)

Wukong Panel is an autonomous VPS node console for individuals and small teams. Any panel can enable a central master to consolidate node lifecycle management, shared subscriptions, real-time rates, host status, and whole-machine traffic billing cycles for the local machine and 2–10 remote hosts in a single secure interface.

## Product Film | Product Film

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a66e91b8-70e7-401b-99b3-439cc35217d2

---

## Core Features

- **Central fleet and multi-machine management**: Any panel can manage the local machine and up to 10 remote VPS instances. Supports real-time network speed monitoring on cards, unified node scheduling, merged cross-machine subscriptions, and lossless smooth switching.
- **Lightweight probe with zero overhead**: VPS instances without a panel can independently install the minimal, stateless `wukong-probe` single binary to report resources and network quality. The central master automatically manages billing-cycle traffic quotas and expiration times, and counters resume accumulating without resetting after a restart.
- **Seven mainstream protocol drivers**: Deep support for Hysteria 2, VLESS + REALITY, VLESS + WS + Cloudflare Tunnel, Shadowsocks 2022, TUIC v5, Trojan TLS, and AnyTLS, with local dual-stack closed-loop handshake self-testing.
- **Device formation and batch management**: A first-of-its-kind device-dedicated node entry. One process and one configuration uniformly manage independent inbound ports and credentials for 2–20 devices. Supports dual-VPS landing IP egress and fail-closed routing protection.
- **Outbound security and zero public exposure**: Remote agents only actively initiate connections through certificate-trusted HTTPS long polling, without opening extra ports or using SSH. The unprivileged web service and the root agent are strictly isolated through a restricted Unix socket.
- **End-to-end network quality observation**: Grouped into international and domestic targets, collects ICMP latency and packet loss in real time, visually presents the past 30 minutes of trends, and supports automatic failover to backup targets.
- **Safe changes and lossless takeover**: Automatically scans and imports existing `/etc/s-box` and systemd services. Configuration change failures roll back automatically within seconds. Automatically requests and renews ACME certificates daily.

---

## Quick Start

Supports Debian, Ubuntu, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux, and Alpine, on `amd64` and `arm64`.

### 1. One-command install of the full panel

```bash
curl -fsSL https://github.com/252201/wukong-panel/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sudo sh
```

On a bare VPS without a pre-installed `curl`, you can use the quick `wget` entry point instead:
```bash
wget -qO-…
```

CLICGGER-TYPES/dsh-piggy.description: 🐖 DeepSeek Harness raising plugin, which can also run as a desktop pet on Windows, Linux, and macOS; supports growth, studying, working, fishing, a collection guide, and skin changes
CLICGGER-TYPES/dsh-piggy.body:
Raise a little pig that grows up, goes to school, works, travels, and chats with you. It's a single-player raising game in the style of QQ pets, with a Nook Phone interface from Animal Crossing. The same codebase comes in two forms: the DSH plugin, which lives inside the DeepSeek Harness web page, and a standalone desktop version.

You can do everything with the mouse. When you're busy, the pig uses items from your backpack to take care of itself. The game does not register model tools or inject pig status into conversations, and caring for the pig uses no model tokens.

## Highlights

- **Raising**: up to level 60, 33 classes, 15 travel locations, 12 personalities, and 1008 lines of dialogue.
- **Garden**: 29 crops across 18 plots, growing in real time. Water, weed, control pests, fertilize, and harvest across multiple seasons. You can hire helpers and schedule patrols.
- **Mini-games**: a 20-floor mine, blind boxes and gacha, fishing with 40 fish, and a Pomodoro timer.
- **Multiple desktop pigs**: up to 4 pet windows sharing the same owner's coins, backpack, and garden.
- **Local first**: saves are on your own machine. Cloud sync and LAN multiplayer are off by default and can be turned on explicitly when needed.
- **Extensible**: skin packs, action and sound asset packs, and online extensions, all with format validation and fallback.

## Two forms

| | DSH plugin | Desktop version |
|---|---|---|
| Runs in | Inside the DeepSeek Harness page | A standalone Electron app |
| Install | `dsh plugin add` | Installer or portable package download |
| Pigs | One pig | One pig, up to 4 windows |
| Saves | DSH's own saves | Local userData; DSH saves can be imported |
| Best for | Raising while you work | Staying on the desktop, multiple pigs, tray |

Pigs in the two forms are independent by default. To merge them, use a full-archive migration after export, preview, and backup. It never overwrites silently.

## Quick start

### DSH plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-piggy
```

After installing, restart DSH and refresh the page. You can also install the alias package [`dsh-plugin-piggy`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-piggy). Only one of the two is needed per profile.

> Installing without a version number installs the npm `latest` tag. To use a preview build, specify the version explicitly, for example `dsh-piggy@0.37.2-rc.11`. npm tags and GitHub Releases may not be in sync, so the release page is the authority.

# HttpMate

## 📝 Project Overview

**HttpMate** is an IntelliJ IDEA plugin that improves REST API development efficiency in Java/Kotlin projects.  
It provides the following frequently used development assistance features:

- Quickly search for and jump to REST endpoint definitions (similar to the search-and-jump experience within the IDE)
- One-click generation of JSON / Mock JSON based on class structure
- Automatic generation of Markdown API documentation based on controller methods
- Code line statistics: right-click a directory to recursively analyze the proportions of code lines, comment lines, and blank lines, including visual charts
- Naming style switching: select text and convert it in one click among camelCase / snake_case / PascalCase / SCREAMING_SNAKE / kebab-case

The plugin currently recognizes endpoints for **Spring Web** and **JAX-RS (javax / jakarta)** through PSI + annotation scanning, and handles interaction and navigation within the IDE.

## ✨ Key Features

1. **Global REST API search and navigation**
   - Shortcuts: `Ctrl + \` or `Ctrl + Alt + H`
   - Supports fuzzy subsequence matching by path/method; `Enter` jumps directly to the endpoint definition
2. **Annotation-level endpoint recognition (Spring + JAX-RS)**
   - Supports `@GetMapping/@PostMapping/.../@RequestMapping`
   - Supports `@Path/@GET/@POST/...` (`javax.ws.rs` and `jakarta.ws.rs`)
3. **JSON structure generation**
   - Right-click a class to generate structured JSON, recursively expanding fields and handling primitive types, collections, Maps, enums, and time types
4. **Mock JSON data generation**
   - Generates random sample data based on field types, for integration testing and writing documentation examples
5. **Markdown API documentation generation**
   - Supports batch generation of documentation per method or per class, including endpoint information, parameter tables, response fields, and request/response examples
6. **Code line statistics**
   - Right-click any directory or package to recursively analyze code lines, comment lines, blank lines, and their percentages across all source files
   - Supports 25+ file extensions; results include a summary panel, colored bar charts, and a sortable detail table
7. **Naming style switching**
   - Shortcut: `Ctrl + Shift + Alt + U`
   - Converts among camelCase, snake_case, SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE, PascalCase, and kebab-case
   - Smart word splitting that correctly handles abbreviations (e.g., `XMLParser` → `xml`, `parser`)

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
```

badhope/moneyhelper.body:
# Moneyhelper

**An AI financial assistant that does the accounting.** Log expenses in one sentence, check holdings, run financial check-ups, and get morning briefings.
All numbers come from a deterministic engine. The model only interprets intent and writes the text, so **it cannot make up amounts**.

Simplified Chinese | [English](https://github.com/badhope/moneyhelper/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | [Architecture details](https://github.com/badhope/moneyhelper/blob/HEAD/docs/ARCHITECTURE-detail.md)

---

## Three forms, one core

| Form | How to start | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| **Desktop installer** | Download `.exe` / `.msi` / `.dmg` / `.AppImage` | People who just want to double-click and open it, without touching the command line |
| **Web + backend** | `docker compose up -d` → `localhost:8787` | Self-hosted servers, multi-device access |
| **CLI** | `moneyhelper add "咖啡 28"` | Keyboard enthusiasts, script integration |

```bash
# Local development (one command: venv + dependencies + frontend build + start service)
scripts/dev.sh --prod        # → http://localhost:8788

# CLI
moneyhelper add "午餐 45 打车 28"    # multiple entries in one sentence, auto-categorized
moneyhelper balance                  # net worth + holdings
moneyhelper ask "这个月花在哪"        # runs the full Q&A pipeline
```

---

## What problem it solves

Most people don't lack bookkeeping tools. They **lack conclusions**.

| Your confusion | Moneyhelper's answer |
|---|---|
| Where did my money go this month? | Category breakdown + month-over-month change + anomalous items |
| Net worth went up. Is it from saving or from gains? | Splits it into net savings / investment gains and losses / changes in liabilities |
| Is my portfolio safe? | Concentration and sector distribution, with limit breaches flagged in red |
| What should I do first? | An action list sorted by urgency (not a list of metrics) |

**Core difference**: instead of giving you yet another dashboard, it chains together "data → judgment → next action".

---

## Key capabilities

### Ledger and holdings

- **Multiple entries in one sentence**: `午餐 45 打车 28 工资 8000` → three transactions, automatically categorized
- **Confirmation before writing**: write operations go through HITL (human-in-the-loop) approval and are not saved until confirmed; duplicate confirmations are blocked by idempotency
- **Appending and weighted cost**: buying the same asset again automatically adds to the share count and recalculates the cost weighted by shares (the existing holding is not overwritten)

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.description: Hong Kong ID card smart ID appointment quota monitoring dashboard: 5-minute detection + email/Feishu slot-release notifications (third-party tool, not official)
chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# HKID Appointment Quota Dashboard

Monitors smart ID card appointment quotas at the six Registration of Persons offices of the Hong Kong Immigration Department, checking about every 2 minutes, and notifies subscribers via email / Feishu group when slots are released. **This is a third-party public-interest tool, not an official Immigration Department service. It only monitors and sends alerts; it does not snatch or book appointments on anyone's behalf.**

## Dashboard entry

- **Preferred (stable direct access from mainland China)**: https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (Access to github.io from mainland networks is intermittent; jsDelivr/raw direct links carry a nosniff header and only display source code, so don't use them as web entry points)
- The full experience in mainland China without a VPN is email subscription + Feishu group. The notification path is entirely direct within China and pushes releases to your phone right away; the dashboard is only a helper

## How it works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ fetch the Immigration Department's public quota API (read-only, one request at a time)
                            │  ├─ diff against the previous snapshot → release events
                            │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refreshes every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger setup: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements over similar tools

- **Mobile-first**: dates scroll vertically as rows, so all 6 offices fit on one screen without horizontal table scrolling
- **Colorblind-friendly**: status cells use both color and text (available / low / full)
- **Notification anti-flooding**: the official API has load-balancing data jitter (observed 304↔346 cells fluctuating within the same minute), so the notification layer uses a per-cell cooldown and doesn't fire on every cycle
- **Direct access from mainland China**: email subscription and Feishu notifications are reachable domestically throughout, no VPN needed
- Light and dark themes; summary cards directly answer 'earliest date you can book'

chenweidaben/JLAIharnessos.body:
# Jianlan AI-Native Hospital Operating System OS

> Repository perspective: **GitCode `JLMEDAIOS` main repository** (BFF / backend services / AI orchestration / data foundation / FHIR gateway / CDS / electronic medical records / internet hospital / knowledge platform / voice / multi-tenancy).
> For the frontend workbench, Vite build, deployment and operations, and secondary development guidance, see [`README.dev.md`](https://github.com/chenweidaben/JLAIharnessos/blob/HEAD/README.dev.md) (the developer mirror perspective on GitHub `JLAIharnessos`).

---

## 1. Project Overview

**Jianlan AI-Native Hospital Operating System OS (`jlmedaios`)** is an AI-native hospital foundation for tertiary public hospitals. It is not a "traditional HIS with an AI add-on". Instead, it fuses **BFF, domain services, AI orchestration, data foundation, FHIR gateway, and CDS** into the same Bun runtime and the same PostgreSQL 16 schema:

- **Access layer**: Bun-native `Bun.serve` simultaneously serves REST (`/api/v1/*`), WebSocket (`/ws/chat`, SSE-style streaming dialogue and critical-value broadcasting), and Prometheus `/metrics`.
- **Domain layer**: Outpatient, inpatient, nursing, pharmacy, surgery, emergency, hospital infection control, medical records, health checkups, internet hospital, multi-tenancy, and other domains are implemented in three layers (routes, aggregators, and repositories). All of them go through unified authentication, auditing, idempotency, and data-masking middleware.
- **AI orchestration layer**: A proprietary Orchestrator providing a declarative YAML/JSON DSL (12 node types), a secure expression sandbox, DAG validation, state machines, checkpoint retry, and manual suspend/resume. It integrates `@anthropic-ai/sdk@0.80.0`, `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0`, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints (DeepSeek by default).
- **Data foundation**: PostgreSQL 16 single database with multiple schemas, Redis 7 for caching, locks, and rate limiting, Kafka 3.8 (KRaft) event bus, Elasticsearch 8 for log search, and a vector store (`bge-large-zh`, 1024 dimensions).
- **Compliance layer**: JWT HS256, RBAC + ABAC, AES-256-GCM field encryption, a hash-chained audit log (retained for ≥180 days), five-layer prompt injection defense, and automatic PII masking. These directly align with EMR Level 6, Interoperability Level 4-A, Smart Services Level 3, and MLPS (等保) Level 3.

danything/denpa-font.body:
# Denpa Font

A monospaced rounded gothic covering the characters used in broadcast subtitles, data broadcasting, and program guides (JIS X 0213 planes 1 and 2, ARIB gaiji, and more).
The corners of BIZ UDGothic (Morisawa) are machine-rounded, and ARIB symbols that do not exist in the original are drawn with parts from BIZ UDGothic.

- Family name `Denpa Font` (PostScript name `DenpaFont-Regular`), em 1024, with advance widths of only half-width 512 and full-width 1024
- The character set is determined from the table at [danything/denpa](https://github.com/danything/denpa), and all of it is included (11,709 characters in v3.6; the web font is split into the 8,128 base characters and the 3,581 kanji added by JIS X 0213). It does not support vertical writing or hinting. It includes `palt`, which tightens full-width alphanumerics, and `ccmp`, which composes two-codepoint characters such as か゚ into a single glyph ([palt: tightening full-width alphanumerics](https://github.com/danything/denpa-font/blob/HEAD/docs/design.md#palt-全角の英数字を詰める))

## Get it

From [Releases](https://github.com/danything/denpa-font/releases).

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `denpa-font.ttf` | TrueType (fontconfig, Android, etc.). One file covering all characters |
| `denpa-font.woff2` | Web font (browsers). Base characters: JIS X 0208, ARIB gaiji, non-kanji characters such as JIS X 0213 symbols and kana, and composed characters such as か゚ |
| `denpa-font-jisx0213.woff2` | Web font (browsers). Kanji added by JIS X 0213 (levels 3 and 4). Uses the same family name as the base file and is registered under it with `unicode-range` |
| `denpa-font-jisx0213.txt` | Character range covered by `denpa-font-jisx0213.woff2` (the value for CSS `unicode-range`, one line) |
| `SHA256SUMS` | sha256 hashes of the 4 files above |

The web font is split into two files. Browsers only fetch `denpa-font-jisx0213.woff2` when a kanji added by JIS X 0213 appears on the screen.

# Owarai GrillMaster

Downloads Japanese variety shows and generates Traditional Chinese SRT / ASS subtitles for easy personal viewing.

So far, [1020 items have been translated](https://space.bilibili.com/277428027/upload/video), and the pipeline is fairly stable.

## Notes

- The goal is to be able to watch in one shot without proofreading (to avoid spoilers)
- Translation and post-processing both use agent subscriptions. Only ElevenLabs ASR is billed, at $0.22 USD/hour. (With `proofread_watch_clip` enabled, Azure MAI-Transcribe-2 and Meta Muse are also used. One final proofreading pass costs about $0.02.) For a 20-plus-minute episode, the time from download to output subtitles is about 30 minutes.
- Configuration preferences are personal and subjective. If you want to change them, please fork the project yourself.
- For more detailed explanations, see the following, or simply hand this repo to your agent:
  - [Reflections 1](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1ZwRQB5ETf)
  - [Reflections 2](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1X5bu6REDU)

## Models

After various experiments, the following setup seemed most suitable:

- **ASR**: `ElevenLabs Scribe v2`. It can recognize speech even when many people are shouting at once, playing dumb, or cracking jokes with no gaps between lines.
- **Translation**: The `Gemini 3` series best captures the flavor of Japanese variety shows, and it is also good at looking at images and listening to audio files.
- **Polishing**: Handled by `GPT` / `Claude`, which fix structural abnormalities and subject misuse in `Gemini` output. They are also more willing to call tools to search the web and verify wording with screenshots.

## Workflow

First, a briefing is prepared for the whole episode (characters, proper nouns, joke translations, tone). Then the subtitles are split into chunks and translated in parallel. During translation, the audio file is consulted, and the model can also use grill's built-in MCP tool (`get_frames`) to choose timestamps and take screenshots itself, identifying characters, scenes, and on-screen text.

```
Download video → speech recognition → full-episode briefing → chunked translation → polishing → term proofreading → final review (optional) → output ASS + SRT → caption card translation (optional) → archiving (optional) → burn-in subtitles (optional)
```

## Installation

Requires Python 3.13+, FFmpeg (added to PATH), uv, and a logged-in agent CLI (`gemini`, `agy`, `codex`; Claude uses the built-in SDK; `gemini`'s Code Assist login requires the environment variable `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT`).

> Antigravity has high token usage, and its content review is stricter, so it sometimes refuses to translate. Gemini CLI has the problem that Gemini 3.1 Pro often returns 429 errors (server overloaded).


hulibuld/dsh-get-it-for-free.description: Integrate free and check-in account channels such as Huawei Cloud CodeArts, Tencent CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy, Qoder, TRAE, Raccoon, LobsterAI, MiniMax, ZCode, and iFlytek Loomy into DeepSeek Harness. Runs purely locally, with no telemetry.
hulibuld/dsh-get-it-for-free.body:
# dsh-get-it-for-free

Connects **free / check-in-style** large model account channels to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH). Log in to accounts in settings, check in daily, and sync the pool of available models. Models then appear in the model picker as regular providers.

Runs purely locally: no telemetry, no self-update, and no requests sent to the upstream repository. Account credentials are written only to the local directory `~/.dsh/get-it-for-free/`.

## What you'll see on first use

The first time you open the settings page, a full-screen notice appears first. Its title is "Those who fear death, do not enter" (贪生怕死勿入斯门). In the center is a blood-red button labeled "Delete this plugin and exit" (删除该插件并退出), and the body is three paragraphs of blunt text. This button **really does uninstall this plugin**. It removes the dependencies and bundle entries from your profile, deletes the plugin directory, and then exits DSH. Accounts and historical data are kept in `~/.dsh/get-it-for-free/` and are not deleted. The almost invisible small text in the bottom right, "Continue using, ignoring the risk." (无视风险继续使用。), is what actually continues.

This notice is not meant to stop people. It exists because using third-party clients to proxy official quotas is explicitly disallowed by the vendors. Anyone willing to accept that risk will naturally click the button on the right. Anyone who is not should click the red one.

## Supported channels

| Channel | Login method | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Huawei Cloud CodeArts | Browser authorization / AK-SK | Credit-based; available models are discovered per account |
| Tencent CodeBuddy / WorkBuddy | Browser authorization | Free-tier models, including daily check-in |
| Qoder (international / China) | Browser authorization | — |
| TRAE | Device code / browser authorization | Includes check-in |
| Raccoon | Browser authorization | — |
| LobsterAI | Browser authorization | — |
| MiniMax | Browser authorization | — |
| ZCode | Browser authorization | — |
| Loomy (iFlytek) | WeChat QR code scan | Models carry a rate multiplier. There are two credit pools, temporary and permanent; the channel only consumes the temporary pool |
| MiMo (Xiaomi) | Already logged in on the desktop app is enough | Reuses the desktop app's cookie, so no account needs to be added; quota resets daily |

## Features

- **Account dashboard**: Manage accounts for each channel on one page (log in / refresh / log out / enable and disable). Login state is stored locally.
- **Daily check-in**: Where a channel supports check-in, you can check in directly or turn on automatic daily check-in. "Connected" and "Auto-checked-in today" are marked with green dots.
- **Extra check-in round at 10:05 every day**: Daily activities for Qoder (China edition) only refresh at **10:00 (UTC+8)**, so the round you see when you start up in the morning still shows yesterday's activities. For this reason, automatic check-in runs once after startup and then again at 10:05 each day, claiming the activities that only appear at that time. This round also closes the gap where the host stays open without a restart and fails to check in the next day after midnight passes.
